# Support

Thank you for using **helancode**.

This document explains where to ask questions, report problems, discuss ideas, and obtain assistance.

## 1. Getting Help

Choose the appropriate channel based on your request.

### GitHub Discussions

For general questions, technical discussions, and community assistance.

[Open Discussions](https://github.com/Emmanuel-Arokiaraj/helancode/discussions)

Use Discussions for:

- Questions about architecture and design.
- Usage and configuration guidance.
- Questions about model providers.
- Tool integration discussions.
- Feature ideas and technical proposals.
- General community discussions.

### GitHub Issues

For reproducible bugs and actionable engineering problems.

[Open an Issue](https://github.com/Emmanuel-Arokiaraj/helancode/issues/new/choose)

Use Issues for:

- Application crashes.
- Unexpected runtime behavior.
- Incorrect tool execution.
- Configuration bugs.
- Performance regressions.
- Reproducible integration failures.

Before opening an issue:

1. Search existing issues.
2. Check whether the problem exists in the latest version.
3. Provide reproduction steps.
4. Include relevant logs and environment information.
5. Remove credentials and sensitive information from logs.

### Documentation

For installation, configuration, architecture, and usage guidance, refer to the project's documentation.

[Project Documentation](https://github.com/Emmanuel-Arokiaraj/helancode)

## 2. Bug Reporting

When reporting a bug, include:

- Project version.
- Operating system.
- Rust version, where relevant.
- Relevant configuration.
- Steps to reproduce.
- Expected behavior.
- Actual behavior.
- Sanitized logs or error messages.

A minimal reproduction is preferred over a long description without actionable details.

## 3. Model Provider Issues

This project may integrate with external model providers.

Issues involving:

- API availability.
- Rate limits.
- Model-specific errors.
- Provider outages.
- Billing and usage limits.
- API authentication.

May originate outside **helancode**.

Please verify provider status, API credentials, model availability, and request limits before reporting an integration bug.

Never share API keys, access tokens, or other credentials in public issues.

## 4. Feature Requests

For feature proposals, use the Feature Request issue template.

Describe:

- The problem.
- The proposed behavior.
- The expected developer experience.
- Relevant use cases.
- Potential architectural implications.

Feature requests are reviewed according to project direction, complexity, and maintenance requirements.

## 5. Security Issues

Do not use public support channels to report security vulnerabilities.

Follow the private reporting process described in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## 6. Community Assistance

Community members are encouraged to help each other.

When asking for assistance:

- Be respectful.
- Provide sufficient technical context.
- Share reproducible examples where possible.
- Avoid posting private source code or credentials.
- Be patient when waiting for responses.

[Read the Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

## 7. Support Expectations

**helancode** is maintained by contributors and maintainers.

We aim to review questions and issues when time and resources permit.

Please understand that:

- Response times are not guaranteed.
- Not every question will receive an immediate answer.
- Community assistance is voluntary.
- Third-party services are outside the project's direct support responsibility.
- Commercial support and guaranteed service-level agreements are not implied.

## 8. Contributing Back

If you discover a solution to a problem, consider contributing it back.

You can:

- Improve documentation.
- Submit a bug fix.
- Add regression tests.
- Improve error messages.
- Share reproducible examples.
- Help answer community questions.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) to get started.

## 9. Contact

- Issues: https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/issues
- Discussions: https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/discussions
- Security: See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)

Thank you for being part of the **helancode** community.
